name: AZ Plug
description: Smart Wi-Fi plug with power monitoring, Amazon Alexa edition
measure_description: No separate measurements. This model reuses the values of `shelly/SNPL-00112EU` (Plus Plug S) and inherits that profile's sub-profiles. The AZ Plug is the Amazon/Alexa edition of the Plus Plug S: Shelly documents the same 12 A / 2500 W rating and the same set of meters (AC voltmeter, AC ammeter, power and energy meters), and the device has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth only, no Matter and no KNX. Sources: https://kb.shelly.cloud/knowledge-base/shelly-plug-s-mtr-gen3 and https://kb.shelly.cloud/knowledge-base/shelly-az-plug
